description: Maintained script inventory. Every tracked Python or shell script is represented exactly once. Root commands are the stable public surface; gates, producers, tools, and libraries use canonical role-oriented paths.

categories.public_entrypoint: Stable commands intended for humans and workflows.
categories.aggregate_gate: Composed validation gates called by public entrypoints or workflows.
categories.producer: Evidence/data producers that create summaries or runtime artifacts.
categories.legacy: Historical compatibility script; avoid new references.

scripts/lib/cpu_capacity_evidence_contra.why_new_script: Capacity evidence parsing and validation need separation from comparison aggregation and CLI reporting.
scripts/lib/cpu_capacity_evidence_contra.replaces: Capacity evidence contracts embedded in aggregate_cpu_capacity_evidence.py
scripts/lib/cpu_capacity_evidence_contra.retirement_condition: Capacity evidence adopts an equivalent versioned schema validator.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_verificat.why_new_script: Compose, image and Prometheus validation contracts need separation from live deployment orchestration.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_verificat.replaces: Pure verification helpers embedded in verify_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_verificat.retirement_condition: Deployment verification migrates to an equivalent schema-backed contract.

scripts/lib/release_sbom_io.py.why_new_script: Safe archive, Conan lock and SPDX identity primitives need an import-safe ownership boundary.
scripts/lib/release_sbom_io.py.replaces: SBOM input and normalization helpers embedded in harden_release_sbom.py
scripts/lib/release_sbom_io.py.retirement_condition: Release SBOM processing adopts an equivalent governed library.

scripts/lib/release_sbom_semantics.py.why_new_script: SPDX enrichment, verification and attestation semantics need separation from argument handling.
scripts/lib/release_sbom_semantics.py.replaces: SBOM semantic operations embedded in harden_release_sbom.py
scripts/lib/release_sbom_semantics.py.retirement_condition: Release SBOM processing adopts an equivalent governed library.

scripts/lib/sdk_full_flow_runtime.py.why_new_script: SDK process, port and runtime-isolation helpers need separation from full-flow orchestration.
scripts/lib/sdk_full_flow_runtime.py.retirement_condition: SDK full-flow verification adopts a replacement governed runtime harness.

scripts/lib/conan_workflow_contract.py.why_new_script: Conan workflow declarations and parsing helpers need separation from the aggregate gate report.
scripts/lib/conan_workflow_contract.py.retirement_condition: Conan workflow policy migrates to an equivalent versioned contract source.

scripts/lib/deploy_operability_contract..why_new_script: Deployment topology declarations and validators need separation from gate orchestration and reporting.
scripts/lib/deploy_operability_contract..replaces: Deployment contract helpers embedded in check_deploy_operability.py
scripts/lib/deploy_operability_contract..retirement_condition: Deployment topology validation moves to an equivalent schema-backed contract.

scripts/lib/evidence_provenance_cases.py.why_new_script: Provenance acceptance and rejection fixtures need an import-safe home separate from CLI reporting.
scripts/lib/evidence_provenance_cases.py.retirement_condition: Evidence provenance fixtures move to a replacement schema conformance suite.

scripts/lib/long_soak_contract.py.why_new_script: Long-soak argument, subprocess and provenance contracts need separation from multi-stage orchestration.
scripts/lib/long_soak_contract.py.replaces: Reusable long-soak helpers embedded in run_long_soak_capacity.py
scripts/lib/long_soak_contract.py.retirement_condition: A replacement soak orchestrator owns equivalent presets and evidence contracts.

scripts/lib/monitoring_operability_contr.why_new_script: Prometheus, Grafana and alert declarations need separation from operational integration checks.
scripts/lib/monitoring_operability_contr.retirement_condition: Monitoring declarations migrate to an equivalent schema-backed policy source.

scripts/lib/raft_mixed_binary_runtime.py.why_new_script: Raft node process and wire helpers need separation from rolling-upgrade decision orchestration.
scripts/lib/raft_mixed_binary_runtime.py.replaces: Node runtime helpers embedded in verify_raft_mixed_binary.py
scripts/lib/raft_mixed_binary_runtime.py.retirement_condition: Raft compatibility evidence adopts a replacement cluster runtime harness.

scripts/lib/sdk_distribution_contract.py.why_new_script: SDK versions, ABI symbols and wrapper validators need separation from artifact and report checks.
scripts/lib/sdk_distribution_contract.py.replaces: SDK distribution declarations embedded in check_sdk_distribution.py
scripts/lib/sdk_distribution_contract.py.retirement_condition: SDK distribution validation migrates to an equivalent versioned compatibility manifest.

scripts/lib/backup_recovery.py.why_new_script: Backup, vault and restore commands require one import-safe implementation instead of importing a peer CLI.
scripts/lib/backup_recovery.py.replaces: Shared implementation previously embedded in manage_backup_recovery.py
scripts/lib/backup_recovery.py.retirement_condition: All backup and restore consumers migrate to a replacement versioned recovery library.

scripts/lib/release_package.py.why_new_script: Release package primitives need one import-safe home shared by multiple stable CLIs.
scripts/lib/release_package.py.replaces: Helpers previously implemented inside release CLI modules
scripts/lib/release_package.py.retirement_condition: All release package consumers move to a different governed library contract.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_core.py.why_new_script: Immutable deployment constants, layout and validation primitives need one CLI-free ownership boundary.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_core.py.retirement_condition: The release deployment controller is replaced by an equivalent governed implementation.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_executor..why_new_script: Host process and systemd execution must be isolated from deployment state transition policy.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_executor..retirement_condition: A governed host executor replaces systemd and Compose lifecycle execution.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_recovery..why_new_script: Manual recovery evidence validation and reconciliation form an independent fail-closed policy.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_recovery..replaces: Recovery reconciliation methods embedded in manage_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_recovery..retirement_condition: Recovery reconciliation moves to a versioned controller with equivalent evidence checks.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_install.p.why_new_script: Immutable input validation and installation require a boundary separate from runtime activation.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_install.p.replaces: Install and versioned layout methods embedded in manage_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_install.p.retirement_condition: Immutable release installation moves to a replacement transactional controller.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_transacti.why_new_script: Interrupted transaction reconciliation is independent from candidate activation and command parsing.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_transacti.replaces: Pending transaction reconciliation embedded in manage_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_transacti.retirement_condition: A durable transaction engine replaces the file-backed reconciliation state machine.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_activatio.why_new_script: Candidate activation and automatic restoration need one directly tested transactional boundary.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_activatio.replaces: Activation and restoration methods embedded in manage_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_activatio.retirement_condition: A replacement deployment controller owns candidate activation and automatic restoration.

scripts/lib/release_deployment_commands..why_new_script: Public lifecycle operations need a small orchestration layer above the transaction policies.
scripts/lib/release_deployment_commands..replaces: Deploy, upgrade, rollback, verify and status methods embedded in manage_release_deployment.py
scripts/lib/release_deployment_commands..retirement_condition: Public lifecycle operations migrate to a replacement controller for one release.

scripts/dev.py.summary: Discover and run bounded contributor diagnostics, governance, tests, and smoke checks.
scripts/dev.py.retirement_condition: A documented contributor facade replaces every command and remains stable for one release.

scripts/run_tests.py.summary: Run repository CTest layers through the toolchain recorded in a configured build tree.
scripts/run_tests.py.retirement_condition: CTest preset selection fully replaces this cross-platform compatibility surface.

scripts/bootstrap_conan.py.summary: Bootstrap the pinned Conan environment and install the governed dependency graph.
scripts/bootstrap_conan.py.retirement_condition: A pinned package bootstrap replaces online and offline modes on every admitted runner.

scripts/generate_conan_lock.py.summary: Regenerate the governed Conan lockfile and its reproducibility metadata.
scripts/generate_conan_lock.py.retirement_condition: Lock generation moves to a governed package-manager surface with equivalent validation.

scripts/verify_release_candidate.py.summary: Run the bounded local release-candidate policy and evidence admission checks.
scripts/verify_release_candidate.py.retirement_condition: The release-candidate policy is replaced and all workflow and maintainer references migrate.

scripts/check_mainline_readiness.py.summary: Validate documentation, configuration, script, and repository governance before merge.
scripts/check_mainline_readiness.py.retirement_condition: A single bounded governance gate replaces its checks and summary contract.

scripts/verify_production_candidate_evid.summary: Aggregate same-candidate production evidence and fail closed on missing provenance.
scripts/verify_production_candidate_evid.retirement_condition: Production evidence policy is versioned forward and all R0 consumers migrate.

scripts/check_production_evidence_manife.summary: Validate the production evidence manifest, decision inputs, and candidate bindings.
scripts/check_production_evidence_manife.retirement_condition: A newer manifest schema and validator are adopted by all production gates.

scripts/render_production_readiness_repo.summary: Render the reviewed production readiness decision from admitted evidence summaries.
scripts/render_production_readiness_repo.retirement_condition: All report consumers adopt a replacement renderer and schema for one release.

scripts/run_long_soak_capacity.py.summary: Orchestrate fixed-runner long-soak and capacity evidence with bounded cleanup.
scripts/run_long_soak_capacity.py.retirement_condition: A replacement N1 soak gate produces equivalent capacity and stability evidence.

scripts/verify_sdk_enterprise_delivery.p.summary: Verify enterprise SDK packaging, consumers, and the released full-flow contract.
scripts/verify_sdk_enterprise_delivery.p.retirement_condition: A replacement N5 gate covers every supported SDK distribution and consumer.

scripts/verify_preprod_recovery_drill.py.summary: Execute the admitted pre-production recovery drill and verify bounded recovery evidence.
scripts/verify_preprod_recovery_drill.py.retirement_condition: A replacement R5 drill validates the same failure, recovery, RTO, and evidence contracts.

scripts/verify_prometheus_alert_states.p.summary: Verify Prometheus and Alertmanager states against the governed production expectations.
scripts/verify_prometheus_alert_states.p.retirement_condition: Alert-state verification moves to an equivalent monitored-environment gate.

scripts/verify_tls_preprod_multi_run.py.summary: Run repeated pre-production TLS and mTLS admission, rotation, and rollback evidence.
scripts/verify_tls_preprod_multi_run.py.retirement_condition: A replacement R6 gate preserves multi-run TLS evidence and rollback coverage.

scripts/verify_macos_arm64_package.py.summary: Verify native macOS ARM64 package identity, consumers, and debug-symbol pairing.
scripts/verify_macos_arm64_package.py.retirement_condition: macOS arm64 package verification is subsumed by an equivalent signed-package gate.

scripts/verify_jwks_rotation.py.summary: Exercise real JWKS key rotation, stale grace, outage behavior, and rollback.
scripts/verify_jwks_rotation.py.retirement_condition: A replacement security drill covers rotation, stale grace, outage, and rollback.

scripts/manage_todos.py.summary: Validate, render, update, and explicitly synchronize the versioned project TODO board.
scripts/manage_todos.py.retirement_condition: The versioned TODO board and Issue synchronization migrate to a governed replacement.

scripts/manage_release_deployment.py.summary: Manage immutable release install, upgrade, rollback, status, and verification transactions.
scripts/manage_release_deployment.py.retirement_condition: A transactional deployment controller replaces install through recovery on admitted hosts.

scripts/check_operations_host.py.summary: Fail closed unless the Ubuntu operations host satisfies the governed admission contract.
scripts/check_operations_host.py.retirement_condition: Host admission policy moves to a replacement with equivalent fail-closed evidence.

scripts/apply_operations_host_baseline.p.summary: Plan or apply the explicit Ubuntu operations-host security baseline convergence.
scripts/apply_operations_host_baseline.p.retirement_condition: A governed converger replaces plan and apply while preserving admission evidence.

scripts/prepare_release_runtime.py.summary: Download, verify, and atomically stage an immutable Linux x64 release runtime.
scripts/prepare_release_runtime.py.retirement_condition: An atomic staging replacement preserves supply-chain verification and rollback inputs.

scripts/build_release_images.py.summary: Build network-disabled runtime-only release images and emit immutable image identities.
scripts/build_release_images.py.retirement_condition: A replacement produces immutable runtime image IDs with network-disabled builds.

scripts/verify_release_deployment.py.summary: Verify resolved production Compose, service health, Redis, and released SDK full flow.
scripts/verify_release_deployment.py.retirement_condition: A replacement verifies resolved Compose, health, Redis, and SDK full-flow equivalently.

compatibility_policy.rule: A non-public root script must name a canonical implementation and may be removed only after active references reach zero.
compatibility_policy.archive_rule: Retired executable code is removed and remains available through Git history; it is not copied into an executable scripts/archive tree.
